Dear Joi,
Please allow me to take a moment of your time to say how grateful I am to you for introducing me to Romy and
Toki!
Romy has put together an incredibly comprehensive itinerary, most of which I am yet to experience, but what I
have so far, was remarkable. I think one of the highlights is going to be the tea ceremony with the 89 years old
tea master lady, who, Romy says, you have met. And thanks to you, I am being very fortunate to be able to learn
about these things from such perspective.
Thank you, thank you!!
Karyna

EFTA00566217
